title: Chapter 164: The Devil's Bargain
html:
Leaving the laundry room, Chen Ge went to the second floor and found Wang Haiming’s former room. Two bare bed frames occupied the small space, their mattresses and covers long gone. For safety, every sharp edge had been removed; even the frames had been deliberately rounded.

“Wang Haiming was sent into the hospital by his second wife. Perhaps there was something wrong with his head, but it shouldn’t have been that serious. I believe this was a conspiracy against the man.”

Assembling everything he knew, Chen Ge realized how complicated Wang Haiming’s life had been.

His fortunes had risen and collapsed, but he had never stopped resisting. Whether forcibly institutionalized or later fighting a monster for control of his body, he struggled to the end. He was no saint—he had betrayed his first wife—but from one perspective, he had paid more than enough for that sin.

“Every patient-room door locks from only one side, so even with a key, it can open only from the corridor. Security doors divide the hallway every twenty meters, and staff patrolled at night. How did Wang Haiming escape?” Sitting on a bed frame, Chen Ge studied the boarded window. “Did he jump?”

Behind the planks, steel mesh reinforced the glass. This was no exit. Beyond the building waited a two-meter concrete wall and dense woods in which even locals could lose their way. Yet Wang Haiming had not only escaped; he had contacted his ex-wife and persuaded her to save him. The feat belonged in a film.

He couldn’t have done it alone. He must have relied on the monster inside him. They cooperated because both wanted to leave the hospital.That explained the escape, but one question remained. When did the monster enter Wang Haiming’s body?

Recalling Xu Tong’s account, Chen Ge noticed something strange. Soon after his first shock “treatment,” Wang Haiming began provoking the doctors and even fought a nurse over hidden medication. Such behavior might have been dismissed in another patient, but Wang Haiming had not been insane.

Did he provoke them deliberately because he wanted to return to the Third Sick Hall?Chen Ge searched the sparse room. Only the curtain and the space beneath the beds could conceal anything.

He moved both frames aside and found a diary scratched into the white paint with fingernails. Time had erased much of the writing, but enough remained to understand its meaning.

“Is it Wang Haiming’s handwriting?” Chen Ge closed the door, shone his flashlight on the wall, and started to read the words on it.

“Have I really gone crazy?

“Two attendants and a doctor dragged me into the electroshock room. Those animals locked the door, so no one else should have been able to enter.

“Why did I see four people in the room after the therapy?

“Who was the person wearing patient clothes?

Wang Haiming had probably written the diary. In a room devoid of entertainment, recording his thoughts became his only diversion. Through long reflection, he realized that he differed from those around him.

“Was he a hallucination caused by the shock? Why could he speak to me? Why was I the only person who saw him?

“He said he could help me escape, but only if I accepted one condition.

“This is truly a devil’s bargain, but I have no choice.

“Something is wrong. Could it be the pills? I fall asleep without warning, as if someone poured lead into my brain. I have to leave.

“The devil doesn’t seem able to leave the Third Sick Hall. If I want to escape this hospital, I’ll have to find him there.

“The staff are heartless animals. I swear I’ll destroy this place!

“The second time I entered that room, I accepted his demand. After I completed the ritual in the bathroom, he entered my body.

“Have I really gone insane to believe there is a devil in this world and accepted his trade?”

The diary ended abruptly. What followed the bargain was perhaps known only to Wang Haiming.

The monster inside him probably came from the Third Sick Hall, and he completed the ritual in a bathroom. Did it require a mirror? If so, the “devil” that possessed him may have been an ordinary mirror monster.Chen Ge knew such creatures were not especially powerful, but they were extraordinarily cunning. Finding no other clues, he left.

Wang Haiming’s mirror monster came from the Third Sick Hall, as did the towering creature on Wang Shenglong’s shoulders. Why did neither remain there?He needed answers. Gripping the hammer, he whistled for the white cat and prepared to enter the Third Sick Hall.

He returned to the fourth-floor passage between the buildings, the same route the twisted-faced man had used.

“The salt hasn’t been moved, so no one has passed this way.”

He pushed open the steel door and plunged into darkness. The tiles seemed to shift beneath his feet. As he crossed into the Third Sick Hall, dread settled over him, cold and heavy, as though a monstrous presence watched from nearby.

Even the fearless white cat hid behind his ankles. Without the kitten-scented jacket, it would probably have fled.

The clue left behind by my parents is here. No matter what, I cannot turn back.

He opened his backpack halfway and adjusted the cleaver until its handle protruded within easy reach.

“Almost time.” His phone read 11:51 p.m. Nine minutes remained until midnight.

As he moved deeper, the entire Third Sick Hall seemed like one vast living organism, the cold drafts brushing his body its slow, measured breath.
